description: UA-Grid-Graph: an open graph dataset of the high-voltage transmission grid of Ukraine (OSM-derived) with topology metrics and a node-classification study is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Vladyslav Titov (National Technical University of Ukraine "Igor Sikorsky Kyiv Polytechnic Institute"). A graph dataset of the high-voltage transmission grid of Ukraine (the IPS of Ukraine backbone: 220 / 330 / 400 / 500 / 750 kV), extracted from the OpenStreetMap-based PyPSA-Eur prebuilt electricity network (Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.14144752, ODbL) and restricted to Ukraine. Coverage: national (UA); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
